summary: Backend retest of the WhatsApp reminders in test mode (dry-run). The compute_dates fix works: clients with a non-string data_contratto (int 12345, list, dict, garbage string) no longer stop the run. POST /api/energia/avvisi-rinnovo/invia-ora returned 200, and the valid TEST client (expiry in 30 days) was in the report with dry_run=true, inviato=false; rinnovo_msg_sent_for was not set; a dry_run wa_log was written. Bollette and vincolo invia-ora returned 200 with dry_run=true, inviato=false, inviati=0 and no sent marks or lavorazione change. ripristina-test returned 200 with keys {rinnovo_energia, bollette, vincolo}; stato returned 200 with dry_run=true. New iter46 suite 10/10, iter45 regression 10/10 (including the previously failing malformed-data test). wa_dry_run was not touched. All TEST_ clients and wa_logs were removed (0 left).

minor.issue: Still not fixed since iter45: `return {"status": "accepted"}` is dead code at the end of avvisi_stato (server.py ~5976), so the cron returns 200 with body null. Move the return back to the end of cron_riparazioni_ferme.

store lookup, store_msg and scadenza_offerta are still outside the per-item try/except. compute_dates is now safe, but a malformed servizio.data_attivazione (if scadenza_offerta does not handle it) could still stop the vincolo run. Not tested in this iteration.

action_items: Restore `return {"status": "accepted"}` in cron_riparazioni_ferme and remove the dead return after avvisi_stato.
Optional: put store lookup, store_msg and scadenza_offerta inside the per-item try in the 3 reminder runs.
critical_code_review_comments: compute_dates catches (ValueError, TypeError, AttributeError), which is correct.
server.py is very large (>6700 lines); split it into modules.
seed_data_creation: TEST_ clients (good + malformed) and their wa_logs were created and then deleted by id (0 left). ripristina-test was run as requested: it only removes sent marks whose last wa_log is dry_run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run iter45 and iter46 in SEPARATE pytest invocations with a gap of more than 30s: TOTP replay protection rejects the same code twice ('Codice non valido'). Command: set -a; . backend/.env; set +a; export REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=...; cd backend/tests; pytest <file> -n 0. Do not turn off wa_dry_run.
rca of the issue: Before the fix, compute_dates did dc[:10] on an int, raising TypeError outside the per-client try, so the whole run returned 500. The fix catches TypeError/AttributeError inside compute_dates, and the client is now skipped with no data_scadenza. Verified.
